# Custom instructions for Copilot

## Project description
Generate sythetic data of drive scene for training relighting model. The generated videos include many different driving scenes with various lighting conditions, weather effects, and time of day variations. For each scene everything should be the same except lighting.

## Coding style
The comment language is English. 

## other instructions
